name: cli-check
body: CLI check command: `kalide check [--all] [--json]` validates the resolved template library layers and the deck's theme (the template library loader's validation) and the whole deck (the deck validator) without serving or binding a port, then prints a summary. It defaults to the validator's fail-fast order reporting the first error, collects every error in that order with `--all`, and with `--json` emits a machine-readable report — a valid boolean, a summary, and each error as an object carrying its file, line, path, message and suggestion. Exit codes: 0 valid, 1 validation error, 2 usage error; it opens no browser and reaches no network (single-binary). It is the non-serving entry point for a pre-commit hook or CI, usable to validate a library's example files and a deck. Owns the check handler in internal/cli; realised by the deck validator (domain.service.validate-deck) and the template library loader (domain.service.load-template-library).
